interpretation: This is a product requirements catalog, not an implemented PDF analyzer or validated clinical decision system. Candidate conflicts require human adjudication.

rules.name: Reference integrity
rules.applies_when: Any reference is populated
rules.check: All object references resolve to IDs of the expected type. Duplicate IDs are errors within a model.
rules.qualification: Schema validation alone does not check foreign keys.

rules.name: Endpoint definition
rules.applies_when: Endpoint is intended for the operative protocol
rules.check: Require measurement identity/version as applicable, time and anchor, transformation, aggregation, baseline definition for change, and responder/subset rules where relevant.
rules.qualification: An intentionally partial extraction is incomplete, not proof that the source protocol omitted these fields.

rules.name: Expression arithmetic
rules.applies_when: A numeric or logical expression is evaluated
rules.check: Check operator arity, dimensional consistency, score domain, baseline denominator, sign, inclusive bounds and null behavior.
rules.qualification: Do not create response values from undefined arithmetic or use hidden rounding.

rules.name: Schedule coverage
rules.applies_when: An endpoint or narrative rule requires an observation
rules.check: Find a matching assessment at an eligible scheduled or event-triggered encounter; account for the window and within-visit order.
rules.qualification: Review footnotes before flagging an apparently absent check mark.

rules.name: Scope and version conflict
rules.applies_when: Two assertions concern the same semantic field
rules.check: Compare values only where study, version, region, population, period and applicability overlap.
rules.qualification: Historical amendment text and different trial designs are not automatically contradictions.

rules.name: Schedule footnote loss
rules.applies_when: A SoA cell has a footnote or merged header
rules.check: Retain predose, subset, optional consent, repeat, remote and triggered conditions on the scheduled activity.
rules.qualification: A table cell may encode several actions.

rules.name: Dose calendar consistency
rules.applies_when: The dose calendar can be expanded from accepted rules
rules.check: Check loading/maintenance overlaps, route and units, repeat limits, dose conditions and administration count.
rules.qualification: Do not expand redacted or unresolved doses into invented schedules.

rules.name: Blinding calendar
rules.applies_when: Treatment assignment is intended to remain concealed for a role
rules.check: Compare observable administration frequency, presentations, placebo administrations and role-specific unblinding dates.
rules.qualification: A difference suggests a masking risk but does not by itself prove unblinding.

rules.name: Participant transition coverage
rules.applies_when: A period has response-based branching
rules.check: Check entry and exit conditions, prior assignment, rescue history, allocations and terminal states for gaps and overlaps.
rules.qualification: If predicates contain investigator judgment, request adjudication instead of claiming exhaustive proof.

rules.name: Time anchor and boundary
rules.applies_when: An action or event has time restrictions
rules.check: Resolve named anchors, Day 0/Day 1 conventions, visit windows, exact-week inclusion, consecutive visits and last-dose versus end-of-period clocks.
rules.qualification: Do not silently decide an ambiguous boundary.

rules.name: Rescue linkage
rules.applies_when: Rescue is permitted or represented as an intercurrent event
rules.check: Require operational permission/escalation, treatment disposition, continued observations and event-specific links to each relevant estimand and analysis.
rules.qualification: Operational drug action is not determined by statistical strategy.

rules.name: Estimand completeness
rules.applies_when: A treatment effect is intended for interpretation
rules.check: Resolve population, treatment conditions, variable, population summary and strategies for relevant intercurrent events, including reasons and precedence.
rules.qualification: A single event can have different strategies under different estimands.

rules.name: Observed versus analysis value
rules.applies_when: An analysis excludes, replaces or imputes a value
rules.check: Keep the original observation and provenance; store derived analysis values and their rules separately.
rules.qualification: Do not transform all rescued measurements into missing source data.

rules.name: Sensitivity versus supplementary
rules.applies_when: An analysis is labeled sensitivity or supplementary
rules.check: Compare the treatment question and estimand IDs. A changed estimand is supplementary under the normalized E9(R1) interpretation.
rules.qualification: Preserve the source-native label and request review of the mapping.

rules.name: Framework-specific statistical inputs
rules.applies_when: An analysis framework has been chosen
rules.check: Require estimator and assumptions. Require testing error rules for tests, priors and posterior specifications for Bayesian methods, and a suitable sample-size rationale.
rules.qualification: Do not demand hypothesis-testing alpha/power for a study explicitly using estimation without testing.

rules.name: Testing dependency graph
rules.applies_when: A hierarchical or other dependent testing family is specified
rules.check: Require defined hypotheses, acyclic prerequisites, clear continuation/stopping rules and scoped decision thresholds.
rules.qualification: Monotone dose order is not a universal rule; use the specified hierarchy.

rules.name: Safety instruction completeness
rules.applies_when: A safety trigger requires an action
rules.check: Resolve threshold and units or responsible clinical judgment, confirmation/retest if applicable, action owner, deadline/anchor, follow-up and restart conditions where relevant.
rules.qualification: A borrowed threshold from another mechanism is a proposed choice, not extracted evidence.

rules.name: Discontinuation and follow-up
rules.applies_when: Treatment is interrupted or permanently stopped
rules.check: Keep drug state, study-participation state, consent scope and follow-up obligations separate; reconcile observation duration with defined safety collection windows.
rules.qualification: A treatment stop does not entail study withdrawal.

rules.name: Source availability
rules.applies_when: Content is absent from extraction or externally referenced
rules.check: Distinguish redaction, image-only content, extraction failure, missing package pages, unavailable dependency and true not-reported status.
rules.qualification: A page-count discrepancy is a package limitation signal, not a clinical protocol defect.

rules.name: Provenance and adoption
rules.applies_when: A value enters the accepted authoring model
rules.check: Record origin, source version/location, normalization, review state and adoption. Proposed text and conflicting assertions require explicit resolution.
rules.qualification: Model confidence cannot substitute for evidence.

rules.name: Planning versus results
rules.applies_when: Enrollment or analysis timing is imported from a registry/publication
rules.check: Keep planned sample size, permissible recruitment adjustments and actually enrolled counts separate.
rules.qualification: A later results value cannot overwrite the protocol design field.

rules.name: Change impact
rules.applies_when: An accepted semantic object changes
rules.check: Traverse dependent endpoints, estimands, analyses, treatment paths, schedules, safety rules and generated views; identify affected reviewers and dependencies.
rules.qualification: Change impact reports do not authorize an amendment.

expression_contract.null_behavior: Missing input propagates unknown unless an explicit missingness or existence rule applies; never coerce unknown to false.
expression_contract.temporal_operators: consecutive(sequence, required_count) requires a declared, ordered eligible-encounter sequence; skipped visits and missing observations require an explicit policy.
expression_contract.type_contract: in expects scalar plus collection; count expects a collection; consecutive expects an ordered predicate sequence and integer count. Collections are resolved fields or supported expression results; this scaffold has no collection literal node.
expression_contract.units: All numeric operations require compatible dimensions. The implementation must validate and version unit conversions.
expression_contract.execution_boundary: Schema describes expressions; it does not implement their interpreter.
